title: Residual Connections & Layer Normalization — Keep an Express Lane Open
key_insight: A residual connection adds a block’s input to its transformed output. The block only needs to learn a useful change, not rebuild everything.
body:
## Keep an Express Lane Open

A useful message passes through many transformations and becomes distorted. A direct copy around each transformation protects the original signal.

A residual connection adds a block’s input to its transformed output. The block only needs to learn a useful change, not rebuild everything.

Layer normalization rescales the features within each token to a steadier range, then learns an adjustable scale and shift.
common_mistakes: Residual connections permanently skip every transformation.
Layer normalization averages unrelated users together.
Normalization removes all learned scale and shift.
mini_exercise: Draw “Keep an Express Lane Open” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: These support stable information and gradient flow through deep transformer stacks.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Keep an Express Lane Open,” explain Residual Connections & Layer Normalization without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
